reviews.review:
This shouldn't have a cost for the state it's in. It's a mess (in VR at least), it's extremely glitchy, all the guns point about 30 degrees lower than they should, item interaction feels bad, the map is empty and ugly and it feels like it was thrown together in an evening. This is literally the worst, most unpolished and poorly designed VR game I've ever played. 
There are free worlds in VR chat that are a lot better than this. 
First thing I've refunded in a long time. 
Save your money and your time, maybe check it out again a lot further down the line, because there's serious work that needs doing here before it should have a price listed against it.
reviews.developer_response:
If you would like to try out the game again let me know.

Also, I've done a ton of VRChat, there are some amazing worlds in there. Which ones specifically are you talking about?

In terms of the gun not rotating to the direction you want, there is an option in the control settings that allows you to adjust the angle of the grip for weapons.

reviews.review:
“Alien Dawn” on Steam is a PC action sci-fi FPS with elements of a zombie survival game. I’ve enjoyed playing because game-play is satisfying and easy to pick up and it’s super fun to play with other players.

I play in VR and character/weapon/gun selection is on point and expansive. If you like selecting cool weapons, Alien Dawn has it's fair share of them. The game feels immersive with various landscapes and really cool caves, highways and mountains. Expect a dark, moody feel especially with ominous music. Be careful, zombies, wolves and aliens with UFO's are out to get you.

I feel a sense of accomplishment when we're loading into the rescue chopper for a dramatic escape. The developers are consistently updating and improving the game and I’ve even seen some of my suggestions implemented right away. As a player, there is no better feeling than knowing your input matters.
Launches in WMR instead of SteamVR.
